title: Electromagnetism - Magnetic Force: The Four Fundamental Forces of Physics #4b
speaker: SciShow
zh: 【SciShow】電磁學 - 磁力：物理學的四個基本力 #4b（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Welcome to our second episode on electromagnetism, one of the four fundamental forces of physics.
cues.en: Welcome to our second episode on electromagnetism, one of the four fundamental forces of physics.
cues.zh: 歡迎收看我們關於電磁力的第二集，電磁力是物理學的四種基本力之一。

cues.text: Like I said last time, there are two aspects to electromagnetic force Electrostatic force which builds up a charge in an object and can travel in the form of an electron stream
cues.en: Like I said last time, there are two aspects to electromagnetic force Electrostatic force which builds up a charge in an object and can travel in the form of an electron stream
cues.zh: 就像我上次說的，電磁力有兩個方面靜電力在物體中產生電荷並且可以電子流的形式傳播

cues.text: and Magnetic force which is responsible for the way magnets work.
cues.en: and Magnetic force which is responsible for the way magnets work.
cues.zh: 磁力決定了磁鐵的工作方式。

cues.text: But even though their effects look different to us, they are in fact, one of the same.
cues.en: But even though their effects look different to us, they are in fact, one of the same.
cues.zh: 但即使它們的效果對我們來說看起來不同，但實際上它們是相同的之一。

cues.text: Hopefully, you remember that electromagnetism acts on objects that have electric charge,
cues.en: Hopefully, you remember that electromagnetism acts on objects that have electric charge,
cues.zh: 希望您記得電磁作用於帶電荷的物體，

cues.text: this charge creates a field around an object.
cues.en: this charge creates a field around an object.
cues.zh: 這種電荷在物體周圍產生一個場。

cues.text: But a magnetic field is a little bit different from an electrostatic field.
cues.en: But a magnetic field is a little bit different from an electrostatic field.
cues.zh: 但磁場與靜電場略有不同。

cues.text: For starters, unlike a charged particle which can either be positive or negative,
cues.en: For starters, unlike a charged particle which can either be positive or negative,
cues.zh: 首先，與帶電粒子不同，帶電粒子可以是正的，也可以是負的，

cues.text: a magnetic field has both a positive and a negative area, what we call a North and South poles.
cues.en: a magnetic field has both a positive and a negative area, what we call a North and South poles.
cues.zh: 磁場有正區域和負區域，即我們所說的北極和南極。

cues.text: Magnets always have both poles, no matter how many tiny little pieces you cut them up into
cues.en: Magnets always have both poles, no matter how many tiny little pieces you cut them up into
cues.zh: 磁鐵總是有兩個極，無論你把它們切成多少小塊

cues.text: But magnetic poles interact much like single pole charged particles, the same poles repel each other and the opposite poles attract.
cues.en: But magnetic poles interact much like single pole charged particles, the same poles repel each other and the opposite poles attract.
cues.zh: 但磁極的相互作用很像單極帶電粒子，同極相互排斥，異極相互吸引。

cues.text: And this like with electrostatic force because its the same force Magnetic force is carried between objects by photons.
cues.en: And this like with electrostatic force because its the same force Magnetic force is carried between objects by photons.
cues.zh: 這就像靜電力一樣，因為它與光子在物體之間攜帶的磁力相同。

cues.text: To demonstrate that electrostatic and magnetic are, in fact, effects of the same force
cues.en: To demonstrate that electrostatic and magnetic are, in fact, effects of the same force
cues.zh: 證明靜電和磁其實是同一個力的作用

cues.text: you can create magnetism using electricity A simple electromagnet is just a coil of wire in which when a current is passed through,
cues.en: you can create magnetism using electricity A simple electromagnet is just a coil of wire in which when a current is passed through,
cues.zh: 你可以用電產生磁性 一個簡單的電磁鐵只是一個線圈，當電流透過時，

cues.text: it generates a magnetic field.
cues.en: it generates a magnetic field.
cues.zh: 它會產生磁場。

cues.text: You can make one yourself by passing an electric current though a wire wrapped around a nail or a screw.
cues.en: You can make one yourself by passing an electric current though a wire wrapped around a nail or a screw.
cues.zh: 您可以將電流穿過纏繞在釘子或螺絲上的電線來自行製作一個。

cues.text: Switch on the current, and the screw becomes a magnet, switch it off again and the magnetism disappears
cues.en: Switch on the current, and the screw becomes a magnet, switch it off again and the magnetism disappears
cues.zh: 接通電流，螺絲變成磁鐵，再次關斷，磁性消失

cues.text: The magnets on your fridge are made basically the same way, only with a lot more electrical power, and using special materials to retain the magnetism.
cues.en: The magnets on your fridge are made basically the same way, only with a lot more electrical power, and using special materials to retain the magnetism.
cues.zh: 冰箱上的磁鐵的製造方法基本上相同，只是功率更大，並使用特殊材料來保持磁性。

cues.text: And, hey, you know what else is an electromagnet?
cues.en: And, hey, you know what else is an electromagnet?
cues.zh: 而且，嘿，你知道電磁體還有什麼嗎？

cues.text: You're living on one.
cues.en: You're living on one.
cues.zh: 你靠一個人生活。

cues.text: The constant churning of the molten iron in the Earth's outer core crates electrical currents
cues.en: The constant churning of the molten iron in the Earth's outer core crates electrical currents
cues.zh: 地球外核鐵水的不斷攪拌會產生電流

cues.text: and those currents generate the Earth magnetic field.
cues.en: and those currents generate the Earth magnetic field.
cues.zh: 這些電流產生地球磁場。

cues.text: Which has proven to be super useful for things like navigation and since,
cues.en: Which has proven to be super useful for things like navigation and since,
cues.zh: 事實證明，這對於導航等事情非常有用，因為，

cues.text: the magnetosphere protects us from solar wind -- not being dead.
cues.en: the magnetosphere protects us from solar wind -- not being dead.
cues.zh: 磁層保護我們免受太陽風的影響——而不是死亡。

cues.text: So an electric current produces a magnetic field, the reverse must also be true,
cues.en: So an electric current produces a magnetic field, the reverse must also be true,
cues.zh: 因此電流會產生磁場，反之亦然，

cues.text: and in fact, yes, you can generate an electric current using a changing pattern of magnetism.
cues.en: and in fact, yes, you can generate an electric current using a changing pattern of magnetism.
cues.zh: 事實上，是的，你可以利用變化的磁力模式來產生電流。

cues.text: If you put a coil of wire within a magnetic field and continuously spin the wire or the magnet,
cues.en: If you put a coil of wire within a magnetic field and continuously spin the wire or the magnet,
cues.zh: 如果將線圈放入磁場中並連續旋轉線圈或磁鐵，

cues.text: so that the magnetic field inside the wire fluctuates, electricity will flow through the wire.
cues.en: so that the magnetic field inside the wire fluctuates, electricity will flow through the wire.
cues.zh: 從而使導線內部的磁場波動，電流就會流過導線。

cues.text: And this is really exciting cause it's the reason why we have electricity.
cues.en: And this is really exciting cause it's the reason why we have electricity.
cues.zh: 這真的很令人興奮，因為這就是我們擁有電力的原因。

cues.text: All you have to do is keep the wire or the magnet moving, and you'll have a continuous source of electricity.
cues.en: All you have to do is keep the wire or the magnet moving, and you'll have a continuous source of electricity.
cues.zh: 您所要做的就是保持電線或磁鐵移動，您將獲得持續的電力來源。

cues.text: Stop moving and the electric current will stop.
cues.en: Stop moving and the electric current will stop.
cues.zh: 停止移動，電流就會停止。

cues.text: This is how pretty much every source of electricity in the world works, from wind turbines, to hydroelectric dams, to coal and nuclear power.
cues.en: This is how pretty much every source of electricity in the world works, from wind turbines, to hydroelectric dams, to coal and nuclear power.
cues.zh: 這就是世界上幾乎所有電力來源的工作原理，從風力渦輪機到水力發電大壩，再到煤炭和核能。

cues.text: The only big exception is solar power, which is really interesting, so we did a whole episode on it.
cues.en: The only big exception is solar power, which is really interesting, so we did a whole episode on it.
cues.zh: 唯一的大例外是太陽能，這真的很有趣，所以我們做了一整集的內容。

cues.text: Which brings us to the conclusion of our series on the four fundamental forces of physics.
cues.en: Which brings us to the conclusion of our series on the four fundamental forces of physics.
cues.zh: 這使我們得出了關於物理學四種基本力的系列的結論。

cues.text: If you have watched all of them, you are now a master, well not quite a master, but you're getting there.
cues.en: If you have watched all of them, you are now a master, well not quite a master, but you're getting there.
cues.zh: 如果您看完了所有這些，那麼您現在已經是大師了，雖然還不是完全大師，但您已經達到了目標。

cues.text: If you don't feel like you have quite mastered them, you can go re-watch those episodes
cues.en: If you don't feel like you have quite mastered them, you can go re-watch those episodes
cues.zh: 如果你覺得自己還沒有完全掌握它們，你可以重新觀看這些劇集

cues.text: Also we'll suggest some books down in the comments that you can continue to develop
cues.en: Also we'll suggest some books down in the comments that you can continue to develop
cues.zh: 此外，我們還會在評論中推薦一些您可以繼續開發的書籍

cues.text: your understanding of THE STUFF THAT MAKES THE WHOLE WORLD WORK.
cues.en: your understanding of THE STUFF THAT MAKES THE WHOLE WORLD WORK.
cues.zh: 您對讓整個世界運轉的事物的理解。

cues.text: Thank you for watching this episode of scishow, if you have ideas or suggestions or questions,
cues.en: Thank you for watching this episode of scishow, if you have ideas or suggestions or questions,
cues.zh: 感謝您觀看本期科幻秀，如果您有想法或建議或問題，

cues.text: Please leave them on our Facebook or Twitter for us to see, or the YouTube comments below
cues.en: Please leave them on our Facebook or Twitter for us to see, or the YouTube comments below
cues.zh: 請將它們留在我們的 Facebook 或 Twitter 上供我們檢視，或在下面的 YouTube 評論中

cues.text: And if you want to keep getting smarter with us please subscribe.
cues.en: And if you want to keep getting smarter with us please subscribe.
cues.zh: 如果您想與我們一起變得更聰明，請訂閱。
